notes.title: Faeland V1.0 Coming 9.9.25! 🧚🏰✨
notes.content:
[b]Dear adventurers, it’s OFFICIAL! 🎉[/b]
Mark your calendars and sharpen your blades!

Faeland V1.0 launches on [b]9.9.25![/b] 🧚🏰✨

[previewyoutube=uztO7Moys3k;full][/previewyoutube]

After over a year in Early Access, we’re thrilled to announce the full release date! Your support, feedback, and encouragement have helped shape Faeland into the adventure it is today, and now we can’t wait to share the remaining content, including the final chapter, with you!

Thank you for being part of the journey. The best is yet to come! 💚

With gratitude and excitement,
The Talegames Team

notes.title: v1.0 Release Date Reveal Coming Soon!
notes.content:

To everyone who’s believed in Faeland, played it, shared it, and stuck with us, this moment is for YOU.

Get ready to flip out with us! We’re almost there! 🤩

notes.title: New Quest Notifications!
notes.content:
[i]Version 0.5.06[/i]

[h2]Chapter 5 - Patch 6[h2]

[h3]Quests[/h3]
[list][*] Reworked the [b]Quest Notification System[/b] with [b]new graphics and sound effects![/b]
[/list]

[h3]Story[/h3]
[list][*] Renamed the Fae Kingdom to [b]Celestria[/b]. Thank you all for your feedback, we had agreed the name needed a change, and it's now officially updated!
[/list]

[h3]Player[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Sprint (Left Stick Press):[/b] Sprint activation using the clickable left stick is now preserved across actions like jumping, crouching, attacking, or transitioning between levels. This reduces the need to press it repeatedly, making sprinting more comfortable when using the stick for movement. The D-pad double-tap sprint remains unchanged and already included this behavior.
[/list]

[h3]Bosses[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Yuson, King of Bandits:[/b] Fixed a glitch where the boss could look in the wrong direction after jumping away from the arena.
[*] [b]Fourth boss:[/b] Separated head and body armor layers in order to improve hit feedback to better communicate the effectiveness of attacks depending on the area hit.
[/list]

[h3]Map[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added boundaries to the map navigation to prevent panning too far away from the visible map area.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a Gemstone item would remain in the inventory after being inserted during a cutscene.
[*] Gemstones must now be inserted in the correct order to preserve story progression and avoid spoilers.
[/list]

[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reviewed and improved various text entries.
[*] Small visual improvements and polish to level art across several areas.
[*] Minor adjustments and fixes to buttons in the Title Screen and Pause Menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Chapter 5 - Patch 5
notes.content:
[i]Version 0.5.05[/i]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list][h3]Quick Menu[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a Quick Menu to quickly select between Weapons, Tools, and Consumables. By default, it can be opened by pressing [b]Tab[/b] on the keyboard and the [b]Right Stick Button[/b] on a gamepad. The binding can be changed via the Title Screen or Pause Menu Settings.
[*] Pending: A tutorial or message to guide new players in using this feature.
[/list][/list]

[h2]Improvements and Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[h3]Fourth Boss Fight[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a case where the boss would not correctly transition between phases.
[*]Tweaked the hitbox in some animations
[*]Added an outline to falling rocks, and adjusted their speed on lower levels to improve visibility and dodging.
[*]Increased regeneration speed per phase, making the combat more dynamic and challenging.
[*]Made the boss HP HUD indicator more responsive when healing and losing HP.
[/list]

[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Fleecan can now be heard crying off-screen; also added small SFX when petting and hugging the Fleecan.
[*] Properly tagged certain sound effects that were not being affected by volume settings.
[/list]

[h3]Level Design[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bleak Caves: Adjusted enemy positioning and the frequency of falling rock traps.
[*] Traps: Fixed an issue where enemies would not die upon falling into spiked traps.
[*] Minor tweaks across multiple areas, including adjustments to object and enemy positioning, collisions, and decorative elements.
[/list]

[h3]Credits[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the text information and adjusted the background music to cycle between different tracks.
[/list][/list]

[*] Sextus Dialogue: Added a first-time dialogue line. In existing save files, he may mention meeting the player for the first time, as this line was not previously implemented.
[/list]

[h3]Cutscenes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Fleecan-free cutscene player appearance, now correctly displays the customized player.
[*] Damerel City camera pan cutscenes: Fixed an issue where the camera would not zoom out as intended due to an error introduced in a previous update.
[/list]

[h3]Player[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed various animation issues related to player layers.
[/list]

[h3]Level Design[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ruins Dungeon: Improved wall jump sections that were unintentionally more difficult than intended.
[/list]

[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*] Various art, dialogue, and level design improvements and fixes.

notes.title: Chapter 5 - Patch 3
notes.content:
[i]Version: 0.5.03[/i]

[h2]Story[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added multiple journal pages scattered in the world as notes, explaining the locations in Chapter 5, their history, key item origins, and Troglund's life journey of discoveries. These notes also convey additional lore and key story points.
[*] Changed the quest item [b]"Troglund's Journal"[/b] to [b]"The Verdant Compendium"[/b] to differentiate between the scattered journal pages and the book containing recipes used in the witch's quest.
[*] Updated the witch's dialogues and the "A Fair Trade" quest to reflect new details about Troglund, his journal pages, his cape, and his compendium.
[*] Fixed an issue where the dragon would still appear for the riddle event after being defeated.
[*] Implemented a temporary fix for the quest "A Letter to the King" to ensure it updates correctly even if previous events were not completed in the intended order. (A more permanent fix to prevent early entry into Damerel is pending.)
[/list]

[h2]Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added two new gameplay settings:

[list][*][b] Directional Evasion:[/b]
The Roll and Backflip actions will switch based on the direction of movement.
(Default: Off)

[*][b] Prioritize Air Kick:[/b]
Pressing Down and Jump in the air will trigger an Air Kick, even if an Air Jump hasn't been performed.
(Default: Off)[/list]
These settings depend on acquiring skills in-game and cannot be changed from the Title Screen to avoid spoilers. They must be adjusted from the Pause Menu.
[*] Improved the "Apply Settings Before Exit" prompt, making it more intuitive and allowing menu exit without saving changes.
[*] Fixed a glitch where the menu screen could fail to exit under certain conditions after making changes.
[/list]

[h2]Player[/h2]
[list]
[*] Introduced a fast-walk behavior in swampy waters. The fast-walk action consumes stamina at a lower rate, and resting recovers stamina faster than sprinting.
[*] Fixed an issue where Riding Fleecan could be interrupted when poisoned or burning.
[*] Fixed a case where rolling and backflipping could be triggered again without finishing the animation.
[*] Addressed movement inconsistencies in swamps where actions like jumping or attacking sometimes failed to connect smoothly.
[*] Fixed various player clothing graphic issues.
[*] Reviewed collision with spike traps that teleport the player back to the last save zone:[list]
[*] Fixed cases where multiple hits could occur, making HP loss from these traps consistent at only 1 hit.
[*] Improved accuracy in determining a safe respawn zone to prevent indefinite respawning onto spikes.[/list][/list]

[h2]Level Design and Art[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the flow and visuals in various levels.
[*] Refined the art in the area where the dragon sleeps.
[*] Optimized memory consumption for multiple sprite assets.
[/list]

[h2]SFX[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added sound effects to the flame thrower traps.
[*] Added sound effects to the appearing spears traps.
[*] Added ambient sounds to the lava in Blazeheart Mountain.
[*] Added sound effects to moving platforms that previously had no sound.
[/list]

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] Croco Lancer: Polished animations; added a new crouch attack to hit below the player's shield.
[*] Lava Golem: Polished animations; improved accuracy of hitboxes for body and attacks; adjusted HP and damage values.
[*] Severum Fish: Updated swim chase animation; polished all animations; improved AI behavior for more natural swimming and attacks.
[*] Static Bat Instances: Corrected red bats to only appear inside Blazing Mountains.
[/list]

[h2]Map[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added button binding visuals in the Map section for Switching Layers (Ext/Int) and Placing Markers.
[*] Fixed certain areas not being mapped properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could be shown on an incorrect map tile.
[/list]

notes.title: Chapter 5 is here!🎉
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38351422/e230fba6ec9083a37eafb2f6737b650fead164c9.jpg[/img]
Chapter 5 is here! 🎉

Adventurers, the wait is over! Chapter 5 of Faeland is now live! 🌟 This update brings new challenges, exciting environments to explore, and the continuation of our hero's journey.

With 5 of the 6 chapters now available, a significant portion of the game is ready for you to experience. This latest chapter adds even more depth to the adventure, paving the way for an epic and mysterious finale that is just around the corner!

We are also thrilled to introduce new character creator options, allowing you to customize your hero with a feminine body type, now fully playable!

Note for returning adventurers resuming from an existing save file:
[spoiler]This update introduces a new Side Quest, which can be triggered by speaking with Hilsbrand (the blacksmith in Damerel Kingdom city). We recommend talking to him first to follow the natural progression of the story, as it will occur naturally for players starting a new game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38351422/edaaa286c2ff403cb09e9716d6c805c8af9260e0.jpg[/img]
[/spoiler]

We cannot wait to hear your thoughts as you dive into this new chapter. Thank you for being a part of this journey with us! 💖

Happy adventuring,
Talegames Team

notes.title: Chapter 5 Trailer!
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

The journey through Ideria continues! ✨ We are excited to announce that Chapter 5 of Faeland is almost here, bringing new challenges, fresh environments to explore, and the continuation of the story that brings you closer to uncovering the mysteries of the land!

This update also introduces new character creator options, including the ability to customize your hero with a feminine body type, a feature we're delighted to finally bring to life!

With only one chapter left in development, we’re nearing the conclusion of this epic journey together, and we couldn’t be more grateful for your support along the way!

[b]Mark your calendars! Chapter 5 launches Fri. December 13th | 3PM ET US![/b]

Thank you for being part of this adventure. We can’t wait for you to experience this new chapter and see what lies ahead!

All the best,
[i]Talegames Team[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix v0.4.14
notes.content:
[h3]Player Mechanics and Abilities:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Player Crouch Slide Revision:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that could prevent hitting the same enemy multiple times with crouch slide kicks.
[*]Reviewed all enemy interactions with the crouch slide. Some enemies may be susceptible to it and trigger a hit animation, others may not react, some may play the hit animation only during certain actions, and others may counter it.[/list]
[*][b]Player Roll & Backflip tweaks:[/b] Slightly increased the distance covered for better positioning against enemies. When sprinting, the roll ability now covers slightly more distance.
[*][b]Player starts a level in the climbing state where intended.[/b]
[*][b]Player Strong Attack Hits reviewed:[/b] Strong attacks now push the player slightly further when blocking, with a greatly increased distance traveled when actually hit.
[/list]
[h3]Enemies and AI Behavior:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Severum (Big fish) enemy AI reviewed:[/b] Now performs directional thrust bite attacks and has a smoother overall swimming flow.
[*][b]Snake enemy:[/b] Reviewed hitbox accuracy, decreased body damage to 0.25 but added poison to its fang attacks.
[*][b]Wild-boar enemy:[/b] Reviewed hitbox accuracy and made its thrust attack stronger.
[*][b]Yuson boss combat:[/b] Reviewed hitbox accuracy; all attacks are now classified as strong attacks.
[/list]

[h3]Tutorials and Guidance:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Added a Tutorial Message after obtaining the Magic Lamp Tool:[/b] Shows how the lamp can be used to burn objects.
[*][b]Added a Tutorial Message after obtaining the Roll Scroll:[/b] Shows how you can dodge enemies.
[*][b]Added breakable containers with arrows next to the first drawbridge:[/b] This hints players and allows replenishment of arrows if needed upon arrival.
[/list]

[h3]Environmental Updates and Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Forest Underground Area:[/b] Fixed a soft-lock that could happen when jumping over a pushable box earlier than intended.
[*][b]Fixed a soft-lock[/b] that could occur when swimming against certain water streams near the Ogres' Ruins Entrance.
[*][b]Harpoon Launcher in the Catacombs:[/b] Can now be blocked with the shield even when standing next to it. Added sound effects.
[*][b]Environment updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Witch's hut now has an animated chimney fire and added fire ambient sound effects.
[*]Damerel City and Castle: Animated some previously static background flags and reviewed other elements.
[*]Falling from the balcony in the City Inn Guest Room or the Castle Guest Room now inflicts no damage.
[*]Various collision and art updates.
[/list][/list]

[h3]UI and Menu Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Title Screen Option From the Pause Menu Reverted:[/b] Fixed an issue introduced in v0.4.11, allowing to return to the Title Screen from the Pause Menu as intended.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v0.4.13
notes.content:
[h3]> Fixes:[/h3]
- The Underwater Ruins area can now be properly mapped.
- Elevator interaction icon updated to better indicate it can move up and down.
- Piranha enemies: adjusted behavior to briefly flee after an attack and fixed an issue where they could get stuck after being hit in certain instances.
- Great Wynn Woods: in the vertical level after exiting the Bleak Cave, adjusted sprint jump distance to the vine to make it more accessible and intuitive.
- Addressed some text symbols not rendering correctly and made minor adjustments to text in reading objects.
- Fixed various environment graphical glitches.

notes.title: New Character Creator Options!
notes.content:
To Our Amazing Community,

We’re beyond excited to finally share something we’ve been working on for a long time: the ability to choose a feminine body type when creating your character! This has been one of the most requested features from our passionate community, and it’s also been a personal goal for us, as developers and gamers alike. We’re thrilled to finally show you what we’ve created!

From the very beginning of the game, you’ll now be able to select your hero's body type, allowing for a greater personalization in how you experience the game world. We’ve taken special care to ensure the new animations are fluid and detailed, as you've come to expect from us.

Whether you’re starting a brand-new journey or revisiting the world with fresh eyes, we believe this update will bring a new sense of excitement to your hero's story. The feminine body type will officially be available with the release of Chapter 5, so get ready!

We know many of you have been eagerly awaiting this, and we can’t wait for you to experience it. Thank you for your patience and unwavering support.

We can’t wait to see how you bring your hero to life!

Talegames Team

notes.title: Hotfix v0.4.12
notes.content:
[h3]Updates[/h3]
> Updated the art and description of some key items.
> Updated the positioning of key items in the Pause Menu for clarity.
> Cinematic images scenes updates:
--- Reviewed some texts for clarity and consistency.
--- Reviewed the format and line breaks for clarity.
--- Added a font shadow in cases where the image is also bright to improve readability.
--- Increased and tweaked the timing of some slides to improve readability.


[h3]Fixes[/h3]
> Fixed an instance where the Earth Gemstone item would not be removed from the inventory after being socketed.
> Fixed an instance where the key to open the last gate in the Bandits Hideout would remain in the inventory after being used.
> Fixed some dialogue parse tags.
> Fix: Upgraded items versions now correctly show the updated name and description in the Pause Menu.
> Fix: Added a door/passage Map Icon that was missing in the Bandits Hideout.
> Other misc. graphics, audio and gameplay improvements and fixes.


[h3]Notes[/h3]
We recently discovered that the Localization Update (v0.4.11) introduced a new bug when returning to the Player Select Screen. To prevent this issue, we’ve temporarily changed the Exit button in the Pause Menu to close the game entirely. This is a short-term solution so that we can all continue benefiting from the fixes and improvements in this and previous builds while we work on investigating and resolving the bug.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.4.11
notes.content:

[b]- New Consumable Item Trading Options in Valia Town Marketplace![/b] You can now exchange consumables to better optimize the healing items you carry at any time.

[h3]> Updates:[/h3]
[b]- Localization Update: [/b]This update involved extensive internal work on localization. All text-based systems, including dialogues, quests, world notes, NPC stores, cutscenes, and UI, have been updated to support future translations. A language option has been added to both the Title Screen and Pause Menu, though English remains the only selectable language for now.
[b]- Damerel City:[/b] Multiple corrections and improvements to some character art, environment art, sound, and collisions, both in exterior and interior areas.

[h3]> Fixes:[/h3]
[b]- Player Crouch Slide: [/b]Fixed instances where the player could not trigger the Crouch Slide skill while standing on mid-ground platforms that also prevent jumping through them.
[b]- Swamps Door: [/b]Fixed a soft-lock glitch that could occur when exiting a scene in the Swamps area.
[b]- Some minor texts edits.[/b]

notes.title: New Core Mechanic Reveal!
notes.content:
[i]Dear friends![/i]

We are thrilled to announce the introduction of a new [b]Sprint[/b] ability!

[previewyoutube=HKKIAOQwtvM;full][/previewyoutube]

You asked, and we listened! Over the past few months, many of you have expressed a desire to play the game at a faster pace, impacting how you explore towns, dungeons, and engage in combat.

After careful consideration, we’ve decided to take action. The new Sprint mechanic aims to satisfy that craving. We are currently balancing enemies; some should not be outrun, so we’re reviewing them, while even slower enemies will have faster chasing movements and animations.

Our Level Design is also under revision; we are identifying possible points where the flow could be disrupted and making necessary adjustments, including ensuring certain treasures remain unreachable until specific events or abilities are unlocked.

Stamina – the new Sprint will consume stamina, requiring you to balance your stats carefully. Spending all your stamina will incur a penalty time during which you cannot sprint or even dodge roll/backflip! This new Stamina system aims to balance the overall difficulty. While the new Sprint ability provides greater control, it also introduces a new feature to master for successful exploration and combat.

While this doesn’t transform the game entirely, we admit that the Sprint ability fundamentally impacts how it’s played.

This feature will likely continue to be experimental, with potential tweaks to the mechanic, enemies, or levels, well after published. Unlike other abilities planned for future Chapters, this is a completely new addition. We are confident it will be highly beneficial in the long run and hope it will be well received by everyone! :D

Since launching Early Access, we’ve made numerous tweaks to the game, significantly improving it. This Sprint ability marks the biggest change we’ve made, driven by player feedback. We thank everyone participating in this phase, playing, and providing feedback. You are all helping to make Faeland the best it can be! :D

When will this be available?
We’ve been working on it for a while now and plan to release it in our next update (Build v0.3.13), so it should be ready in the coming days! :D

Once published, please let us know your thoughts!

Cheers!

The Talegames Team
